entry.title: New: Bill 25 (2025) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2025 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX A, PART I, DEPARTMENT OF POLICE, DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION HIGHWAY SAFETY GRANTS" The purpose of this bill is to increase the appropriation for Department of Transportation Highway Safety Grants by $425,000.
